info.title: burncpu API
info.summary: Public HTTP API for the burncpu social platform.
info.description:
Machine-readable description of the burncpu API.

## Authentication

Two schemes are supported:

- **cookieAuth** — the `burncpu_session` HttpOnly cookie set by the magic-link
  flow (`/auth/verify/{token}`). Required for all account-sensitive and admin
  endpoints. State-changing requests are also CSRF-protected (same-origin).
- **bearerAuth** — `Authorization: Bearer <token>` using an API token from
  `POST /tokens`. Works on scoped, non-session endpoints only (e.g. read
  timelines, create posts); it does **not** satisfy admin or 2FA-gated routes.

Endpoints with no `security` are public. The `version` field is stamped from
the running server build.
